FULL TEXT:
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE DIRECTOR GOVT. MEDICAL COLLGE,
MAHABUBNAGAR
Notification For Research Scientist-II, Research Scientist- I,
Lab Technician and Lab Assistant Cum DEO (Grade ‘A’)
Notification No.01/MRU/GMC-MBNR/2026,
Dt.06.11.2026.
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for appointment to the
posts of Research Scientist-II (Scientist-‘C’), Research Scientist- I (Scientist ‘B’),
Lab Technicians and Lab Assistant Cum DEO (Grade ‘A’) on contract basis to
work in Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU) at Govt. Medical College,
Mahabubnagar for a period of one year under control of the Director, Govt.
Medical College, Mahabubnagar.
The Notification and application forms available in the Govt. Medical
College, Mahabubnagar website (http://gmcmbnr-ts.org/) and the filled applications
along with all the necessary document should be submitted to the office of the
Director, Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar with demand draft,
Scientist Rs. 1000/- and Others Rs. 500/- in favour of “COLLEGE
DEVELOPMENT SOCIETY GOVT MEDICAL COLLEGE MBNR” (Non
refundable) drawn from the any nationalized bank.
Schedule: -
Application submission from 09-11-2026, 11.00 am.
Last date for submission of application 13-11-2026, 5.00 pm
Display list of eligible candidates 17-11-2026
Interview of eligible candidates 18-11-2026
1. The applications should be submitted at Office of the Director, Govt. Medical
College, Mahabubnagar - 509302 through in person (OR) by speed post on or
before:13-11-2026, by 5.00 pm all working days only.
2. The applications will not be accepted after the last date & time.
3. Selection process will be done as per guidelines of Department of Health
Research (DHR), Ministry of Health & Family welfare, Govt. of India.
4. Making any recommendations or references will be an irrevocable
disqualification over all the merits of candidates.
5. The above notice/selection will be cancelled without any prior intimation on
as per the administrative grounds.
6. The Candidates are instructed to bring the all Original Certificates at the
Time of Interview.
7. Candidates should be applying for both posts are to submit separate
application forms with separate DD’s.
8. Applications not signed by the candidate are liable to be rejected.
Note: Any changes in the scheduled dates will be notified in the website.
Vacancies and Remunerations:-
Sl. No Name of the Posts No of Posts Remuneration Per Month
1 Research Scientist-II (Scientist-‘C’) 1 67,000/- + HRA
2 Research Scientist- I (Scientist ‘B’) 1 56,000/- +HRA
3 Lab Technician 2 20,000/- +HRA
4 Lab Assistant Cum DEO (Grade ‘A’) 1 20,000/- (Consolidated)

Note: - Reference will be given to the candidates having highest medical
qualification.
Special Notes:
1. Above Posts will be recruited on contract basis only for one year which may
be extended based on performance and sanction of funds.
2. Post will not be considered as permanent, at any point of time.
3. Pension/GPF/PF/Leave Benefits will not be applicable.
4. If the fact, that false information has been furnished or that there has been
suppression of any material information in the application form, comes to
the notice at any time during the service of a person, his service would be
liable to be terminated.
5. The selected staff will be eligible for fifteen (15) days leave in a calendar
year.
6. The contract may be terminated at any point of time if the performance
is not satisfactory, with 1 week notice.
7. After scrutinizing the applications received from the candidates, eligible
candidates will be called for interview.
8. No TA/DA will be paid for attending interviews.
9. The above posts will be restricted only to the Multi - Disciplinary
Research Unit (MRU) at Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar.
